children: RNS Number : 6837S  Renewables Infrastructure Grp (The)  01 September 2026

In accordance with Listing Rule 6.4.9, the Company announces that it has been notified that with effect from 1 September 2026, Tove Feld, a Non-Executive Director of the Company, has been appointed as a Non-Executive Director of Windar Photonics Plc, a company which is listed on the AIM Market of the London Stock Exchange.
